import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem odd_power_factorial_growth (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
  have h₁ : ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
    intro n hn
    have h₂ : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
      have h₃ : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
        have h₄ : ∀ k : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → 3 * k ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) * Nat.factorial k := by
          intro k hk
          induction' hk with k hk IH
          · norm_num
          · cases k with
            | zero => contradiction
            | succ k' =>
              cases k' with
              | zero => contradiction
              | succ k'' =>
                cases k'' with
                | zero => contradiction
                | succ k''' =>
                  cases k''' with
                  | zero => contradiction
                  | succ k'''' =>
                    simp_all [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
                    <;>
                    ring_nf at *
                    <;>
                    nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) k'''',
                      pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) (2 * k''''),
                      pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) (2 * k''''),
                      pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 2) (2 * k''''),
                      Nat.factorial_pos k'''' ]
        exact h₄ n hn
      have h₅ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) * Nat.factorial n ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
        have h₆ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) * Nat.factorial n ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
          have h₇ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by
            omega
          have h₈ : 0 ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
            exact Nat.zero_le _
          have h₉ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) * Nat.factorial n ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
            nlinarith
          exact h₉
        exact h₆
      linarith
    exact h₂
  exact h₁ n hn

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem odd_power_factorial_growth (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hdiv : 3 ∣ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by
    clear hn
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        norm_num
    | succ n ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨k, hk⟩
        refine ⟨4 * k - 1, ?_⟩
        have h : 2 * Nat.succ n + 1 = (2 * n + 1) + 2 := by
          omega
        rw [h, pow_add]
        norm_num
        omega
  
  have hcoeff : 3 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by
    have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by
      positivity
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd hpos hdiv
  
  have hpred : 3 ≤ n - 1 := by
    omega
  
  have hlt : n - 1 < Nat.factorial (n - 1) :=
    Nat.lt_factorial_self hpred
  
  have hle : n ≤ Nat.factorial (n - 1) := by
    omega
  
  have hfact : n * Nat.factorial (n - 1) = Nat.factorial n := by
    exact Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
  
  have hgrowth : n ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
    calc
      n ^ 2 = n * n := by simp [pow_two]
      _ ≤ n * Nat.factorial (n - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hle
      _ = Nat.factorial n := hfact
  
  calc
    3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * n ^ 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n ^ 2) hcoeff
    _ ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) hgrowth

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem odd_power_factorial_growth (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : 3 * n ^ 2 ≤ (2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1) * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hfac : ∀ m : ℕ, 4 ≤ m → m ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial m := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        norm_num
    | succ m hm ih =>
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        calc
          (m + 1) ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 * (m + 1) := by
            nlinarith
          _ ≤ (m + 1) * Nat.factorial m := by
            simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m + 1) ih
  
  have hfac2 : n ^ 2 ≤ Nat.factorial n := hfac n hn
  
  have hpow : 3 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 := by
    have hexp : 2 ≤ 2 * n + 1 := by
      omega
    have hp : 2 ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) := by
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hexp
    have hfour : 4 ≤ 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) := by
      norm_num at hp ⊢
      exact hp
    omega
  
  nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Nat.factorial n) hpow]
